name: Veronika Wax
headline: Founder & CEO at demodesk.com | 🤖 AI sales agents that use conversations to automate CRM admin, coach sellers & eliminate blind spots.
summary:
I'm the founder & CEO of Demodesk, where we're building AI that gives sales teams superpowers. We've raised $15M in venture capital, launched four software products, and built a world-class team obsessed with one thing: transforming the way sales gets done.

I’m passionate about creating technology that augments humans, not replaces them—tools that make us faster, sharper, and more impactful. Whether it’s automation, workflow design, or AI-powered insights, I love the challenge of making complex things feel effortless.

Beyond software, I’m into design, music, sports, and exploring everything around longevity and human performance.

I also angel invest and enjoy backing bold, ambitious founders with a strong vision and the grit to build something enduring.

Let’s connect if you're building in AI, sales tech, productivity, or just geeking out on where technology is headed next.

company.description:
🚀 AI Sales Agents That Help Teams Sell Smarter, Faster

Sales teams are overwhelmed with admin work, scattered insights, and inconsistent coaching. Reps spend hours updating CRMs, writing follow-ups, and tracking deals—slowing down pipeline velocity and costing businesses millions in lost revenue.

At Demodesk, we’re changing that.

Our AI Sales Agents work alongside your team to automate execution, improve decision-making, and help every rep perform at their best.

💡 What Demodesk Does:
✅ AI Sales Assistant – Automates CRM updates, drafts follow-ups, and tracks deal progress
✅ AI Sales Analyst – Surfaces deal risks, forecasts pipeline trends, and delivers real-time insights
✅ AI Sales Coach – Analyzes sales conversations, provides instant coaching, and helps reps improve call by call

🚀 The result? More deals closed, stronger execution, and better coaching—without the manual work.

🔹 Used by fast-growing B2B sales teams, consulting firms, and industrial sales organizations
🔹 Integrated with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive and major CRMs
🔹 Works out of the box—no complex setup needed

💡 Scale your sales team’s efficiency with AI Sales Agents.
👉 Try for Free or Book a Demo at www.demodesk.com
